mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Notices returns one row per Commerce publication, newest first. Cases resolves a whole proceeding into one row: where it stands now, which notice said so, and the full history.

searchTerms.title: Product or company search
searchTerms.description: What to look for, for example "aluminum extrusions" or "solar cells". Leave empty with no case numbers to sweep every AD/CVD notice in the date range.

caseNumbers.title: Case numbers
caseNumbers.description: Commerce case numbers such as A-570-135 or C-570-946. A is antidumping, C is countervailing, and the middle three digits are the country.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Filter to goods from these countries, for example China, Vietnam, South Korea. Commerce writes country names several ways and they are normalised before matching.

dutyType.title: Duty type
dutyType.description: Antidumping targets selling below fair value. Countervailing targets foreign subsidies. Many products are subject to both at once.

stages.title: Lifecycle stages
stages.description: Narrow to specific kinds of action. Leave empty for all of them. Note that reviewRescinded ends a review, not the order, while orderRevoked ends the order itself.

dateFrom.title: From publication date
dateFrom.description: Earliest publication date as YYYY-MM-DD. In cases mode a narrow window can hide the order notice itself, which shows up as a status of activeOrderInferred.

onlyActiveOrders.title: Only cases with an order in force
onlyActiveOrders.description: Cases mode only. Drops revoked orders, negative determinations and open investigations, leaving the cases that cost money today.

includeOmnibusNotices.title: Include multi-case notices
includeOmnibusNotices.description: Commerce publishes round-up notices listing dozens of unrelated cases, such as scope ruling lists and the monthly opportunity to request a review. They are part of a case history but never set its status.

newOnly.title: Monitor mode: new documents only
newOnly.description: Remember what has already been returned and emit only what is new. Run it daily to catch an order, revocation or rate change on your products the day it publishes. Quiet runs cost nothing.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows. Case rows cost several requests each, so keep this modest in cases mode.
